svg.text: CUDA-embedded Tile DSL - 16x16 Primitives - LCF/LCSF Templates - H100/B200 - ICLR 2025
L1 - Applications + Integration (production kernels - PyTorch demos - per-kernel build)
L2 - CUDA-Embedded DSL (kittens.cuh header-only - C++20 - PyTorch/NumPy-inspired)
C++20 concepts - layout checks at compile time
mma requires col layout B - silent fail prevention
mul - exp - cumsum - mma - layernorm on tiles
L3 - Tile Data Types (managed layouts across GPU memory hierarchy)
Pipeline staging buffers for TMA loads
gl<type, batch, head, rows, cols, tile>
HBM tensor views with tile indexing
Used for GEMM and attention kernels
Producer handles memory stores in loop
Single kernel full LLM layer execution
L5 - Hardware Primitives + Operations (tensor cores - TMA - multi-GPU)
Match or beat cuBLAS on B200 GEMM
L6 - Kernel Library + Build (kernels/ - demos/ - tests/ - self-contained Makefiles)
L7 - NVIDIA GPU Hierarchy (Thread - Warp - Warpgroup - Block - Grid)
LCF GEMM Kernel Flow (under 100 LOC - 855 TFLOPs H100)
Setup: common_setup - SUPER_M L2 tiling - persistent grid task_id mapping
Producer: tma::load_async A/B tiles - INPUT_PIPE_STAGES pipeline - arrive barrier
Consumer: warpgroup::mma_AB accum - mma_async_wait - register increase 232
Finish: warpgroup::store to shared - tma::store_async C - finish_finished barrier
PyTorch: cd kernels/gemm - make - PyBind11 wrapper - import and call from Python
Attention: LCF attn_fwd_template matches FA3 - no ping-pong scheduler needed
Design Position: Tile-First CUDA DSL vs Triton/CUTLASS
Header-only embed in CUDA - not a separate compiler - hardware-native 16x16 tiles
Tile DSL in CUDA - LCF/LCSF templates
NVIDIA Scope Hierarchy (TK maps to each level)
Thread - Warp - Warpgroup(4) - Block(N warps) - Grid(M blocks)
Register at warp - Shared at block - Global/HBM at grid - TMA bridges levels
Design Position (hardware-up tile DSL - simplicity + speed without leaving CUDA)
16x16 tile primitives - LCF producer/consumer templates - TMA/WGMMA/tcgen05 - megakernel schedulers
Init: clone repo - #include kittens.cuh - define layout+template - lcf::kernel - cd kernels/* - make
